name: browser-use
headline: enhanced claude skills for workflow efficiency
short_description: Claude Skills Supercharged enhances workflow automation by integrating Haiku prompt analysis and critical skill scoring. It benefits operations teams by enabling context-driven, friction-free workflows. The skill connects to Claude agents and TypeScript-based systems, improving efficiency in automated processes.
author: jefflester

sections.overview:
Claude Skills Supercharged automates skill injection for Claude Code by analyzing prompts with Claude Haiku 4.5 and scoring skill relevance with 95%+ accuracy. The system automatically loads high-confidence skills (>0.65 confidence) into context, tracks loaded skills per session to prevent duplicates, and caches results for 1 hour to reduce costs. It eliminates manual skill invocation, supports bidirectional skill affinity loading, and includes dependency resolution with circular dependency detection. Development teams benefit from friction-free workflows where the right context loads automatically—reducing setup time and improving coding efficiency.
Automatically load python-best-practices when writing Python code
Inject api-security skill when discussing REST API endpoints
Load git-workflow skill for commit message and branching questions
Auto-inject guardrail skills to enforce critical best practices
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jefflester/claude-skills-supercharged`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
